item_short_desc: Rothco's 45 Liter Tactical Backpack is designed for versatility and durability. With a spacious main compartment capable of holding up to 45 liters, the tactical backpack is ideal for various outdoor activities. The top features a drawstring closure and elastic top cover with quick-release buckles for easy access to your belongings. Zippered side pouches offer additional storage for gear and supplies. Adjustable and padded shoulder straps ensure all-day comfort, while the breathable padded mesh back allows for comfortable weight carriage.
description: Rothco's 45 Liter Tactical Backpack is designed for versatility and durability. With a spacious main compartment capable of holding up to 45 liters, the tactical backpack is ideal for various outdoor activities. The top features a drawstring closure and elastic top cover with quick-release buckles for easy access to your belongings. Zippered side pouches offer additional storage for gear and supplies. Adjustable and padded shoulder straps ensure all-day comfort, while the breathable padded mesh back allows for comfortable weight carriage. The hip belt enhances stability and weight distribution, making it perfect for long treks. D-rings and MOLLE webbing provide options for securing extra gear and accessories.
